message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: High-level: employer (legal representative) fails to pay wages to 51 employees, total 378,912 RMB. Government ordered payment, still not paid. Company assets were auctioned, paying 115,206 RMB to employees. The defendant escaped, phone off, etc. He was later arrested and confessed.

What crime? Likely "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay labor remuneration) which in Chinese criminal law is "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (failure to pay wages). In examples, they used "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier example: "拒不支付劳动报酬" was used for case of not paying labor wages. So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "逃匿" but that's not a crime per se, but could be "逃避债务" but not. The main crime is refusal to pay wages. So single crime.

Thus final answer.
